acceptanceCriteria: The import command either imports a verified observation file with a test, or is removed from package.json contributions and the spec with the spec amended.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. extensions/vscode/src/observations.ts:84-91 decodeObservation throws UNVERIFIED_IMPORT unconditionally, so the contributed import command can never succeed. Either implement verified import or remove the command and its contribution.
title: VS Code Import Test Observation command always fails
